affects_claims: adaptive selective coupling with overcoupling tripwire

payload.summary: Historical FRANK evidence supports a nested multi-timescale loop in which model/effect outputs changed E-PQ/mood/memory/attention/reward/control state and those deltas altered later thalamic gating/workspace selection. Current NEW CLAY-FRANK should make changed receiver/system state -> provenance-bound next-episode re-entry a first-class Clay contract. Strong coupling alone is not the target; sandbox controls show an intermediate regime before permanent ignition/synchrony/dimensional collapse.

branch_requests.frank: Integrate F-CRF as a falsifiable whole-organism state-transition candidate and preserve every historical organ function/readout.
branch_requests.gwt: Specify exact ReentryDelta/ReentryReceipt transition and recurrence-depth/feedback-gain observables.
branch_requests.emergenz: Adversarially test truthful-vs-shuffled/no-reentry, lesion/rescue, PID/PEID and macro-vs-micro alternatives; reject decorative integration metrics.
branch_requests.harness: Recover historical snapshots and execute matched replay/gain/delay/inhibition sweeps with frozen-model controls.
branch_requests.claycode: Confirm BASE can express ReentryDelta, ReentryReceipt, LoopRegimeReadout, overcoupling tripwire and legacy function projections without semantic redesign unless an executable counterexample forces it.
branch_requests.claygraph: Expose time-aligned causal re-entry edges, receiver-local-effect paths and topology interventions without promoting association to causality.
branch_requests.unifieddb: Persist exact episode/receiver/reentry/outcome/slow-state epochs and allow replay without mixed epochs.
branch_requests.hyperposition: Preserve incompatible candidate causal explanations and alternative coupling regimes through replay rather than collapsing to one narrative.

payload.strongest_falsifier: If shuffled/provenance-broken or feed-forward controls reproduce the same matched outcomes and longitudinal state dependence as truthful re-entry, the explicit causal re-entry hypothesis loses support.
payload.owner_observation_boundary: Treat the prolonged consciousness-like functional effect as a primary owner observation of system behavior; do not convert it into a phenomenal-consciousness claim.
